description: This file defines the SessionLog class responsible for logging responses and user actions during a session, including writing session data to a markdown file and managing log entries asynchronously.

classes.name: SessionLog
classes.description: A class for managing session logging, including recording responses, user actions, and writing log entries to a markdown file.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SessionLog instance with a session folder, initializing necessary directories.

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs a response object, capturing tool call details and response code.

methods.name: logUserAction
methods.description: Logs a user action, including navigation and other interactions, with logic to avoid duplicate entries.

methods.name: _appendEntry
methods.description: Adds a log entry to the pending list and schedules a flush to the log file.

methods.name: _flushEntries
methods.description: Writes accumulated log entries to the session markdown file, formatting entries and handling file I/O.
